business_problem: Caterpillar needed to help engineers, developers, and Condition Monitoring Advisors work through large volumes of machine and proprietary data faster so they could detect equipment issues and prepare service recommendations without time-consuming manual analysis across multiple systems.
solution_summary: Caterpillar describes an in-house AI implementation spanning machine-learning-based condition monitoring and generative AI assistance for service workflows. In the field, machine data from Cat-connected assets feeds Caterpillar's Condition Monitoring suite, which Cat dealers use to detect issues and recommend service or maintenance based on data from the machine itself. For the advisor workflow, incoming asset data and information pulled from multiple systems are analyzed and automatically prepared into a concise report. Caterpillar then applies GenAI to summarize the prepared data and create a draft recommendation before a human reviewer acts on it. Condition Monitoring Advisors review, approve, or edit the recommendation, keeping a human in the loop while reducing manual preparation time. Separately, Caterpillar developers use GenAI to query large proprietary information collections and retrieve practical answers faster than manual document review.

solution_components.name: Condition Monitoring
solution_components.role: This suite analyzes machine data from Cat-connected assets so dealers can detect issues and recommend service or maintenance.

solution_components.name: GenAI
solution_components.role: It prepares concise reports from incoming data and drafts recommendations for Condition Monitoring Advisors to review and approve or edit.

data_flow: Data from Cat-connected assets and other internal systems enters Caterpillar's Condition Monitoring workflow, where machine-learning-based analysis identifies issues and assembles the relevant context. GenAI then summarizes the prepared inputs into a concise report and drafts a recommendation, which a Condition Monitoring Advisor reviews, edits if needed, and uses to support customer service guidance.
business_outcome: Caterpillar reports that GenAI now gives Condition Monitoring Advisors a concise prepared report with a draft recommendation, significantly reducing the time required to prepare data and create recommendations while retaining human review.
architecture_clues: Machine data from connected equipment is an explicit input to the condition monitoring workflow.
The advisor workflow aggregates data from multiple systems before GenAI summarization.
A human-in-the-loop approval step remains in place for recommendations.
Caterpillar also uses GenAI internally to query large proprietary information collections.
